home.kicker: Official partner · Myanmar and international visitors
home.title: Visit Chiangmai Ram with a clear plan
home.lead: This is the partner channel for Myanmar guests and other visitors on the incentive visit plan. We show only hospital-published centres and 2026 check-up prices. Then a coordinator talks with you by email and Telegram until the visit feels right.
home.step1: Open the centre or package that matches your request. Every paragraph is copied from hospital-published information.
home.step2: Send one request in English or Myanmar. Tell us the visit you want. We do not diagnose by form.
home.step3: A coordinator continues with you by email and Telegram until you are satisfied with the incentive visit plan.
home.notEmergency: This partner site is for planned visits, not emergency care.

specialties.title: Specialty centres
specialties.intro: These are the centres Chiangmai Ram Hospital publishes for this campus. We do not add unpublished departments.

packages.title: Health Check Up Package 2026
packages.intro: This is the hospital 2026 promotion table. A coordinator can walk you through STANDARD, ADVANCE, or PREMIUM by email and Telegram.
packages.adminLater: New hospital promotions can be added later from the staff panel when the hospital sends them.

contact.title: Request a partner visit
contact.intro: Send this request in English or Myanmar. A coordinator follows up by email and Telegram. Choose a partner package, a specialty centre, or write what you need.
